name: PYROCAST Database
model_or_instrument: Himawari-8, GOES-16, GOES-17, ERA5, ETOPO5, NRL pyroCb detection algorithm
size_as_stated: over 148 pyroCb events linked to 111 wildfires between 2018 and 2022, equivalent to over 18 000 hourly observations

scales.note: 200x200 grid of 1 km pixels around wildfires, hourly observations spanning 2018-2022 (5 years).
